name: intraday_shadow_bias
expression: (Min(open, close) - low) / (high - low) - (high - Max(open, close)) / (high - low)

name: shadow_asymmetry
expression: EMA((Min(open, close) - low - (high - Max(open, close))) / (high - low), 15)

name: intraday_gap_fill
expression: -(open / Ref(close, 1) - 1) * Sign(close - open) * CsRank((high - low) / open)

name: pv_accum_dist
expression: Sum((2 * close - high - low) / (high - low) * volume, 20) / Sum(volume, 20)

name: momentum_decay_high_low_range
expression: Decay(high - low, 7) / Mean(high - low, 30) * Sign(Mean(close, 20) - Ref(Mean(close, 20), 60))

name: volatility_compressed_breakout
expression: Std(high - low, 10) / Mean(high - low, 30) * CsRank(high - low)

name: vol_range_std
expression: Std(high - low, 15) / Mean(high - low, 15) * CsRank(high - low)
